summary: Treat a worktree as part of a disposable task environment with explicit integration checkpoints.

items.text: Provision each task with a manifest of branch, worktree, runtime namespace, ports, secrets scope, owner and expiration time.
Use an overlap detector based on planned files, dependency graph and symbols to sequence high-conflict tasks before agents start editing.
Automate safe cleanup only after commits are integrated or archived and all untracked state has been surfaced for review.
See Agent-Workforce Management for the related use case or counterpoint: Manage agents like a workforce — roles, costs, allowances, escalation paths.
